title: AI startup Mirage streamed a 24-hour "live" AI news show on X on August 11, which cost ~$50K in tokens, featuring realistic avatars that struggled to converse (Alex Konrad/Upstarts Media)
summary: Alex Konrad / Upstarts Media: AI startup Mirage streamed a 24-hour “live” AI news show on X on August 11, which cost ~$50K in tokens, featuring realistic avatars that struggled to converse — Inside the good, the bad, and the ugly of a 24-hour live AI broadcast experiment by video startup Mirage.
